Getting started

Will it work for the way we share?

Can I try it before inviting everyone?

Yes. Try the calendar with your groups and dates first. You can explore without an account; create one to save your house, then invite the others when you’re ready.

What if we already have a schedule?

Choose “Build it yourself” to put your existing plan on the calendar. Or start with a rotation and change individual dates afterward, so the family that always gets the Fourth of July can keep it.

Does everyone need to sign up?

It’s best if everyone joins, so each person can see the calendar, book their own dates, and get reminders. But if your great-aunt doesn’t do email, she can still come. You can hold dates for her when you’re allowed to book them. They’ll show under your name, so you’ll be the one to keep her posted.

Share the costs

No more “who paid for that?”

Plan annual expenses or split a bill when it comes in. Everyone can see the same numbers, so nobody has to carry the spreadsheet alone.

Money stays where your group already pays it. SplitHaus helps you plan, record, and confirm outside payments. It does not move money between members.

Illustrative amounts for a fictional house. Shared Costs is included in the free year.

The house guide

Keep what you know about the house.

Some things are learned over years: how to close up for winter, who to call when something breaks, what was fixed last time. Keep those notes within reach of everyone who shares the place.

Sample house guide · fictional entries

  • Water shutoff: Laundry closet, behind the lower shelf.
  • Last fix: Kitchen faucet replaced in April.
  • Repair contact: Saved with the plumbing notes.

The lockup routine, thermostat, and trash day.

The familiar routine, written down for anyone staying.

  • Thermostat and lockup
  • Trash and recycling day
  • What to leave ready for the next group

Seasonal work and repairs already done.

What the group has learned about keeping the house in good shape.

  • Seasonal care notes
  • Maintenance history
  • Things to check next spring

Pricing

Try it free for a year.

The calendar and Shared Costs are included. No card to start.

Calendar$119 / house / year

After the free year. Everyone who shares the house can use it.

Shared costs · optional$79 / house / year

After the free year, keep it if you want. Record payments made outside SplitHaus.

Will I be charged when the free year ends?

No. You don’t enter a card to start, so there’s no automatic charge when the free year ends. You choose whether to subscribe.

What happens to Shared Costs after the free year?

It’s included during the free year. After that, the calendar is $119 per house per year, and you can choose to keep Shared Costs for another $79 per house per year.

Does SplitHaus collect money from members?

No. Your group pays using the method it already uses. SplitHaus helps you plan and record those outside payments.

What if we share more than one house?

Pricing is per house. Each house can have its own calendar, group, and subscription.
